This template is to be used for articles with '''''more than 5 redlinks'''''. Remember to click "[show]" in the "Credits" and "Appearances" sections if redlinks aren't immediately visible.

For articles that ''do not'' detail real-life media: <code><nowiki>{{Redlink|hide}}</nowiki></code>
